summary: The ShopLite Orders API has 3 endpoints and a reasonable request schema for POST /orders, but the contract has gaps that let invalid data through and leave error behaviour undefined. GET /orders/{orderId} has no auth and no 404, the cancel endpoint documents no errors or response body, and three string fields have no limits.

request_validations.why: An order with no items must never be created
Without a maximum, a huge quantity can break stock and pricing

request_validations.rule: Required string matching the SKU pattern, max 32 characters
request_validations.why: Unbounded strings risk injection and log flooding
Unknown payment methods must be rejected before calling the payment provider
Matches the business rule in SL-101 and blocks malformed codes early
Free text shown to couriers is a stored-XSS and size risk

negative_tests.title: Empty items array
negative_tests.expected_error: items must contain at least 1 item

negative_tests.title: Unsupported payment method
negative_tests.expected_error: paymentMethod must be one of card, cod

negative_tests.title: Another shopper's order
negative_tests.request_change: Use a token for user B to read user A's order
negative_tests.expected_error: Order not found (do not reveal that it exists)

negative_tests.title: Cancel a shipped order
negative_tests.expected_error: Order can no longer be cancelled

schema_checks.assertion: Body validates against the Order schema; id, status and total are present; status is pending or paid
total is a number >= 0 with 2 decimal places, and currency is a 3-letter ISO code
Error body follows a single error schema (code, message, field)
Body validates against the Order schema, with no extra undocumented fields
Returns the Order with status cancelled (once the spec documents this)

spec_gaps.recommendation: Add bearerAuth and document that shoppers can only read their own orders
Document 401 and 404 with the shared error schema
Return the updated Order so clients and tests can assert the new status

spec_gaps.gap: string fields items[].sku, couponCode and deliveryNote have no length, format or pattern
spec_gaps.recommendation: Add maxLength and pattern so the contract enforces the business rules
Define a reusable Error schema in components and reference it from every 4xx
